items.title: Effectively addressing inequality requires a comprehensive approach that tackles all phases of inequality
items.content:
A conceptual framework diagram consisting of three vertical columns overlaid by an overarching horizontal arrow banner at the bottom:

1. Column 1 (Icon: Group of four people):
   - Heading: "Inequality in building productive capacity"
   - Description: "Invest in early life opportunities and human capital formation."

2. Column 2 (Icon: Person wearing a hard hat):
   - Heading: "Inequality in utilizing productive capacity"
   - Description: "Reduce market and institutional distortions that restrict access to markets and earning opportunities."

3. Column 3 (Icon: Money bag with percentage symbol):
   - Heading: "Inequality in taxes and transfers"
   - Description: "Enhance fiscal redistribution that delivers long-term inclusive growth."

Overarching Banner at Bottom (Double-ended horizontal arrow across all three columns):
   - Text: "Improve the productive capacity of the poor"

Source: World Bank.
